# BCS, The Chartered Institute for IT

> > BCS is the professional body for IT, offering membership, professional registration, qualifications, and career development for the UK's 68,000+ IT professionals.

BCS (The Chartered Institute for IT) is a chartered professional institution founded in 1957 that sets standards for IT professionalism, delivers qualifications, and supports career development across the technology sector. The organization serves individual professionals, educational institutions, employers, and training providers.

## Key Topics

- Chartered IT Professional (CITP)
- Professional Registration
- CPD (Continuous Professional Development)
- SFIAplus Skills Framework
- IT Apprenticeships
- Membership Grades (MBCS, MITP, etc.)
- Digital Skills Development
- Cybersecurity
- Professional Standards
- Career Pathways
- AI and Ethics
- RITTech Registration
- Qualifications and Certifications
- Member Communities
- Higher Education Partnerships

## Membership & Professional Registration

- [BCS Membership](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/become-a-member): BCS membership overview, grades, benefits, and professional development pathways
- [Chartered IT Professional (CITP)](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/get-registered/chartered-it-professional): CITP professional certification standard and application process for IT professionals
- [Professional Registration Routes](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/get-registered): BCS professional registration routes including CITP, RITTech, and competency frameworks
- [Organisational Membership](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/membership-for-organisations): BCS organizational membership packages for companies and professional development
- [Academic Membership](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/academic-membership): BCS academic membership connecting universities with industry and student development
- [Our Members](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/our-members): Member profiles and stories showcasing BCS's diverse 60,000-strong community

## IT Careers & Professional Development

- [IT Careers](https://www.bcs.org/it-careers): BCS IT career guidance, apprenticeships, and professional development resources
- [IT Apprenticeships](https://www.bcs.org/it-careers/apprenticeships): BCS IT apprenticeship standards and career pathways in data, cybersecurity, and tech
- [Continuous Professional Development (CPD)](https://www.bcs.org/it-careers/continuing-professional-development-cpd): CPD guidance and professional development planning for IT career advancement
- [SFIAplus IT Skills Framework](https://www.bcs.org/it-careers/sfiaplus-it-skills-framework): SFIAplus skills framework for assessing IT competencies and career progression
- [Career Quiz](https://www.bcs.org/it-careers/tech-career-quiz): Interactive career quiz matching skills to IT roles and job opportunities

## Education & Training

- [Teachers, Schools and Colleges](https://www.bcs.org/deliver-and-teach-qualifications/teachers-schools-and-colleges): BCS IT qualifications and resources for schools, colleges, and computer science education
- [Training Providers and Adult Education Centres](https://www.bcs.org/deliver-and-teach-qualifications/training-providers-and-adult-education-centres): BCS-accredited training providers and adult education centers for IT qualifications
- [Develop Your Digital Team](https://www.bcs.org/develop-your-people/develop-your-team-or-organisation): BCS organizational partnerships for digital team development and skills training

## Community & Engagement

- [Member Communities](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/member-communities): Overview of BCS specialist groups, regional hubs, and member networking communities
- [Volunteering with BCS](https://www.bcs.org/membership-and-registrations/member-communities/volunteering-with-bcs): BCS volunteering opportunities and roles supporting branch and specialist groups

- [BCS Homepage](https://www.bcs.org): BCS homepage introducing The Chartered Institute for IT and its 68,000+ members
